features.name: Independent Bonaqu application identity
features.supersession_rule: Keep permanently while Bonaqu Client exists; never reuse Telegram Desktop installer/runtime identity.

features.name: Isolated default Bonaqu profile
features.supersession_rule: Keep the Bonaqu default isolation layer even if upstream expands profile support. Rebase onto upstream storage APIs when available.

features.name: Bonaqu multi-profile manager
features.supersession_rule: If Telegram Desktop ships first-class multi-profile working directories, migrate Bonaqu profiles to the upstream mechanism and retain only Bonaqu-specific convenience UI.

features.name: WEB Proxy transport testing and integration
features.upstream_equivalent: Telegram Desktop WEB Proxy development implementation
features.supersession_rule: Follow upstream implementation. Remove Bonaqu-only compatibility glue when WEB Proxy becomes stable upstream, retaining diagnostics if still useful.

features.name: Bonaqu Control Center
features.supersession_rule: Keep as the home for Bonaqu-only settings; remove individual rows when upstream fully replaces their behaviour.

features.name: Connection and WEB Proxy diagnostics
features.supersession_rule: Prefer upstream diagnostic APIs if added; retain a compact Bonaqu summary/export view.

features.name: Enhanced download tools
features.supersession_rule: Extend the upstream Downloads section rather than fork it. Drop duplicate actions when upstream reaches parity.

features.name: Additional power-user shortcuts
features.supersession_rule: Use upstream shortcut actions when they appear; keep only Bonaqu-exclusive bindings and conflict detection.

features.name: Bonaqu visual identity, themes and accents
features.upstream_equivalent: Telegram themes and custom app icons
features.supersession_rule: Build on upstream theming APIs. Avoid maintaining a parallel renderer.

features.name: Optional local voice transcription
features.supersession_rule: Keep only when it offers a useful offline/privacy/local alternative. Never spoof Premium entitlement or server transcription state.
